messages:
Devon Park: Heads-up — updated retention toggle inline helper is getting long; in narrow consoles it wraps to 3 lines and overlaps the region picker. Can we trim? Screenshot: https://redwood.app/snap/abc123
Mia Chen: Ah yeah saw that. It also reads verbosely in VoiceOver, causing the user to hear 'Retention period ... This will...' — feels repetitive. Thoughts on keeping short + link to docs?
Sam Rivera: Agree. Proposal: keep in-line hint to 1 sentence, then 'Learn more' link that opens a modal with full details. That modal can have role='dialog' and proper heading for a11y.
Ada Liu: For KMS label — current 'Managed by Redwood' vs 'Customer-managed key' is okay but we need aria-describedby pointing to the small explanation, not repeating the label. Otherwise SR reads both twice.
Lee Park: FWIW, in responsive view the hint is pushed under the region dropdown and hides the chevron. Repro steps: shrink to 800px, go to Settings > Data, look at Retention toggle.
Devon Park: @Mia @Sam can we get copy options? Also p0: ensure the 'Learn more' is keyboard focusable and trap focus in modal. @Ada can you confirm recommended aria pattern?
Mia Chen: Copy options — short: 'Retention: period of stored data (see details)'. Short alt: 'Retention — how long we keep request logs'. Long: 'Retention controls how long logs and model outputs tied to requests are stored. This affects costs and compliance. Learn more.'
Ada Liu: For aria, use `aria-describedby` on the toggle to point to the detail link ID, not the whole explanation. Modal should have `aria-modal="true"` and focus management. Avoid role='alert' here.
Sam Rivera: UX: Maybe use an info icon instead of inline text on narrow screens. Icon button with aria-label='Retention details' and popover content. That avoids wrapping noise and keeps layout clean.
Lee Park: +1 to icon approach. Need to ensure contrast of icon meets 4.5:1. Current blue is 3.8:1 on white.
Devon Park: I'll prototype icon with popover. @ui-bot deploys a quick storybook if we push branch. Can someone mock copy into ticket?
Mia Chen: I'll paste the short/long copy into #design-ticket-1856 and tag @Sam for review. :thumbsup:
ui-bot: Storybook preview deployed: https://staging.redwood/story/retention-help-1856 — test keyboard nav and SR with VoiceOver. (automated)
Sam Rivera: Thanks! I'll test in VoiceOver on iOS. If issues, we'll fallback to modal.
